answer: Copying the same citations across 238 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 238 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the shale check immediately, the voyage audit keeps the resolved set and the echo replay makes public exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
